messages:
marcus: Quick flag  I'm finalizing the 0.10.1 relnotes and found several out-of-sync SDK examples in the snippets gallery. PR 511 updates the JS/py examples but there's a mismatch with the migration guide. Can someone sanity check?

linh: Which examples exactly? I can pull the PR and run the snippet tests locally.

marcus: The CLI->SDK mapping in the migration guide still shows the legacy flags e.g. `--txt` vs new `--input`. Also the Python streaming snippet uses `on_token` callback, but the SDK now emits delta objects.

tara: I left comments in PR 511 requesting the migration note to include a one-line pattern to transform callbacks: `on_token -> on_delta` and example of accessing token text `d['token']` -> `d.token`. Keep it terse.

dev-bot: snippet-tests INFO  running gallery/snippets against PR 511...

dev-bot: snippet-tests ERROR  python/streaming_example.py failed at line 23: AttributeError 'dict' has no attribute 'token'

linh: That lines up  PR used attribute access but our test harness runs the latest released SDK which returns dicts. We need to ensure both dict and attr access are shown or show conversion example `DotDict(d)` in the snippet.

tara: Hmm, rather than suggest a runtime utility, maybe show an explicit compatibility shim: `token = d.get('token') or getattr(d, 'token', None)` so folks migrating from old objects and new ones are covered.

marcus: Good idea. Let's add a two-line compatibility snippet in the migration section. Also add a tiny callout under Known Issues about a transient telemetry gap affecting snippet rendering in the preview site (was intermittent last week).

qa-jen: FYI I saw the preview render issue too. It was linked to a race in CDN invalidation. We should include the workaround: force-refresh the preview URL. I'll add a short note and ticket link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RED-2039

linh: I'll update PR 511 to include the shim and fix the CLI flag table. After that I'll re-run snippet-tests locally.

dev-bot: snippet-tests INFO  re-run queued by linh...

dev-bot: snippet-tests PASS  all examples in gallery/sdks now pass under Python 3.11 and Node 18.

marcus: Nice. One more ask from product: please include a non-technical one-line blurb about the "Adaptive routing" feature in the relnotes; they want the wording to be consumer-facing and link to the internal strategy doc. Keep it as a single sentence.

tara: I'll draft: "Adaptive routing dynamically balances cost and latency by routing requests to the best available model variant; see internal strategy for details." Is that ok?

marcus: That's fine. Add product's link tag per the format they prefer.

dev-bot: ci-md LINT  warning in docs/whats-new/0.10.1.md: wrap lines at 100 chars.

linh: Fixed wrapping, updated PR. Also updated the snippets gallery index so the JavaScript example points to the new `redwood.infer` methods instead of `RedwoodClient` global.

qa-jen: I'll validate the preview after you push. Please don't merge until QA thumbs.

marcus: Pushed changes and requested review from @eng-runtime and @qa-jen.

eng-runtime: Reviewed  small comment on the streaming shim to prefer explicit dict access for safety. All else LGTM.

qa-jen: Preview looks good to me. Verified streaming example runs in a sandbox and the migration table is readable on mobile. Thumbs.

marcus: Merged and scheduled the doc publish job for the release window. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.

linh: Thanks all  noted follow-up item to add a tiny example in the SDK changelog showing the CLI->SDK flag equivalences. I'll open PR 513 for that.

marcus: Filing follow-ups: RED-2040 (snippet gallery index sync), RED-2041 (changelog appendix CLI mapping). Closing the relnotes coordination thread.
